map.理论面积(亩) = 幅宽(m) × 速度(km/h) × 时长(h) × 1.5: Theoretical area (mu) = width (m) x speed (km/h) x duration (h) x 1.5; efficiency ratio = actual efficiency / theoretical efficiency x 100%; lost area = theoretical area - actual area
map.与农机效率对比同源经验系数（1.5 亩/(m·km/h·h)）。理论效率 = 理: It uses the same empirical coefficient as the machinery efficiency comparison (1.5 mu/(m*km/h*h)). Theoretical efficiency = theoretical area / duration, actual efficiency = actual area / duration, and their ratio is the efficiency ratio. >=85% is excellent, >=70% good, >=55% fair, otherwise low; used to evaluate machine utilization and idle losses from field transfers and headland turns.
map.效率 = 作业面积 / 纯作业小时（亩/h）。: Efficiency = working area / net working hours (mu/h).

map.：旋耕机 6 h 完成 360 亩 = 60 亩/h，深松机 6 h 完成 18: : a rotary tiller finishing 360 mu in 6 h gives 60 mu/h, while a subsoiler finishing 180 mu in 6 h gives 30 mu/h. Rotary tillage is faster but shallow, subsoiling slower but it breaks the plow pan. Choose by the target plow layer rather than speed alone, often combining the two.

map.深松阻力大、需降速保质量，且深度要求严。它不是替代旋耕而是补充，解决土壤板结，频: Subsoiling has high resistance, needs reduced speed to keep quality, and has strict depth requirements. It does not replace rotary tillage but complements it, breaking up compaction, and is done less often than rotary tillage.
map.亩/h 会和标称不符？: Can mu/h differ from the nominal figure?
map.厂家标称多在理想条件。实际受地势、作物、机手水平影响打折扣，应以自家实测均值做计: Manufacturer nominal figures are usually given under ideal conditions. Actual results are discounted by terrain, crop and operator skill, so planning from your own measured average is more reliable.
